describes: Which lines sit inside a fenced code block, fence lines included — the CommonMark rules viz/src/fence.ts implements: up to 3 spaces of indent; a run of 3+ backticks or tildes; a backtick opener's info string may not contain a backtick; a fence closes only on a run of the same character at least as long, with nothing but whitespace after it; an unclosed fence runs to end of input. `mask[i]` is true when `lines[i]` is fenced. Every plain content line is a lone lowercase word, so a consumer that only reports per-line results (the handoff_rows awk) may replace it with a probe without changing the fence structure. Run by viz/src/fence.test.ts, tools/update-adopters.test.mjs and tools/drift-checks.test.mjs.
